summary: OpenWorld, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,494,084 common shares plus 1,023,901 pre-funded warrant shares and 2,517,985 Series A and 2,517,985 Series B warrant shares, priced at $1.39 per share-and-two-warrant unit, matching the October 28, 2026 Nasdaq close. Series A warrants strike $1.53 (five-year term) and Series B $1.39 (18-month term), both exercisable only after shareholder approval. Maxim Group is exclusive placement agent at a 7.0% cash fee. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and approval timing.
